rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Filesystem-Server provides secure file system access for AI assistants through a set of tools that enable reading, writing, listing, and manipulating files within specified allowed directories. Built with Go using the mark3labs/mcp-go framework, it implements strict path validation to prevent directory traversal attacks and unauthorized access outside permitted areas. The server can be deployed as a Docker container with configurable allowed directories, making it ideal for workflows requiring controlled file operations like document management, code editing, or data processing while maintaining security boundaries.
